mechanisms.evidence: THIS S08 0:00.667 versus PREVIOUS S08 0:00.667 eliminates shirt tails, closes the hem and reduces wordmark size. One left-chest mark, plain sleeves, cuffs and pleated trousers remain. APPROVED anchor still differs in collar geometry, stripe thickness and added detailing.

THIS S08 0:06.000 versus PREVIOUS S08 0:06.000 places the head farther left and changes the exposed fist/wrist configuration. Cap and glasses remain recognizable; room landmarks and camera composition align. Broad action survives, but exact pose preservation fails.

THIS S08 0:00.667, 0:03.333 and 0:06.000 retain consistent mastic colour, chest-band placement, collar opening, left-wordmark location and closed hem through changing gestures. E1's construction errors were also persistent; these samples establish no separate temporal improvement.

review.readiness_reason: Major garment-reference mismatches and protected-performer alterations remain; performance preservation regressed despite the improved hem closure.
review.summary: Aleph improves garment closure and maintains consistent construction at sampled instants, but does not reproduce the approved jacket or preserve the performer exactly. Findings concern S08 only, not native-rate timing or intervening frames.

defects.description: The replacement adds slanted pocket openings, pronounced outer-sleeve seam lines and dark centre-zip edging not present in the visible approved construction. Additional zipper hardware cannot be established.
defects.evidence: THIS S08 0:00.667 exposes a dark diagonal hip opening and contrasting zipper border. THIS S08 0:03.333 shows strong forearm seam outlines. APPROVED anchor lacks these conspicuous details.
defects.recommended_action: Regenerate the jacket without invented pocket cuts or pronounced piping; match the reference zipper treatment while protecting the corrected hem.

defects.description: The collar is a short, rounded stand rather than the reference's tall, outward-flared construction. Visible shirt collar and tie above the closed chest zip are correct and are not an open-jacket defect.
defects.evidence: Against APPROVED anchor, THIS S08 0:02.000 has substantially reduced collar height and spread. THIS S08 0:04.667 retains the compact neckline during the head turn.
defects.recommended_action: Restore the approved collar height and flare without concealing the neckwear or reopening the chest-to-hem closure.

defects.description: The chest band remains shallower relative to the torso than the reference stripe. Its single-band count and navy appearance are otherwise compatible with the requested construction.
defects.evidence: APPROVED anchor shows a deeper horizontal band. THIS S08 0:03.333 and PREVIOUS S08 0:03.333 both render a comparatively thin strip; this mismatch was not repaired.
defects.recommended_action: Match stripe thickness using torso-normalized reference proportions; retain one small wordmark on the wearer's left.

defects.description: Exposed hand positions depart from the matched performance. These differences extend beyond jacket silhouette or sleeve volume and violate the requirement to leave Fendi's pose untouched.
defects.evidence: THIS S08 0:03.333 places both crossed hands visibly below their positions in PREVIOUS S08 0:03.333, while the door geometry remains aligned.
defects.recommended_action: Protect source-master hands and body landmarks with immutable masks; constrain garment generation around the original gesture rather than reconstructing exposed anatomy.

defects.description: Local facial reshaping changes the beard/jaw silhouette and mouth configuration. This does not establish a different person, but the face is not identical at the supplied matched instant.
defects.evidence: THIS S08 0:00.667 shows a fuller lower beard contour and different mouth opening than PREVIOUS S08 0:00.667, despite closely corresponding cap placement and head orientation.
defects.recommended_action: Restore the original source-master face and beard region; exclude facial features from generative wardrobe reconstruction and verify with registered same-frame overlays.
